name: Stadtturm
description: Landmark watchtower built in the 1400s with an observation deck & a copper-clad onion dome.

name: Innsbrucker Hofgarten
description: Landscaped royal palace gardens dating from 1410, with a pavilion, butterfly house & restaurant.

name: Golden Roof
description: Ornate Habsburg residence decorated by 2657 shiny tiles now a museum charting Innsbruck history.

name: Triumphal Arch
description: Roman-style triumphal arch, built by Empress Maria Theresa in 1765 to celebrate her son’s wedding.

name: Dom St. Jakob
description: Grand 18th-century baroque cathedral with an ornate interior & iconic painting of the Virgin Mary.

name: Altstadt Innsbruck
description: Old town set against the Alps with the copper-tiled Golden Roof, Imperial Palace & lively cafes.

name: Alpenzoo Innsbruck - Tirol
description: Mountainside conservation-minded zoo, for rare Alpine birds & animals from wolves to golden eagles.

name: Annasäule
description: 1703 monument featuring an ornate red marble column topped by a statue of the Virgin Mary.

name: Bergisel Ski Jump
description: Ski-jump venue that has an updated design by architect Zaha Hadid, with a viewing platform & cafe.

name: Father and Son or Anno Nine - War Memorial
Schloss Ambras Innsbruck
description: Late renaissance castle now a national museum housing portrait collections, art & an armory.

name: Court Church Innsbruck
description: Ornate Gothic church with tombs of Emperor Maximilian I & Archduke Ferdinand, & 450 year-old organ.

name: Hofburg Innsbruck
description: 16th-century, later Renaissance & Baroque imperial palace, housing lavish interiors with frescoes.

name: Tyrolean Folk Art Museum
description: Tyrolean folk-art collection with artifacts displayed in the period rooms of a historic building.

name: Stiftskeller
description: Beer & classic Tyrolean recipes served in a warm, nostalgic space with archways & wood beams.

name: Le Murge
address: am Wiltener Platzl, Leopoldstraße 27, 6020 Innsbruck, Austria

name: Hotel Grauer Bär
description: Airy rooms & suites in an upscale hotel with a steakhouse, a spa & a 2-story sunroom with a cafe.

name: Adlers Hotel
description: Elegant rooms & suites in a modern hotel offering a rooftop restaurant/bar & a spa with saunas.

name: Altstadthotel Weisses Kreuz
description: Stylish rooms, some with balconies, in a 15th-century boutique hotel with a contemporary bar.

name: Leipziger Hof Innsbruck
description: Understated hotel featuring a bar/restaurant & a sauna, plus a relaxation area with mountain views.

name: Hotel Schwarzer Adler Innsbruck
description: Polished rooms & suites in a genteel 16th-century property featuring a cozy bar & a warm eatery.

name: The Penz Hotel
description: Chic rooms & suites, some with mountain views, plus a rooftop bar & a breakfast buffet.

name: Hotel Goldener Adler, BW Signature Collection
NALA individuellhotel
description: Stylish quarters in a hip hotel with a trendy eatery, a rooftop terrace & mountain views.

name: Innsbruck University Botanical Garden
description: Circa-1911 university botanical garden with diverse plant species & several greenhouses.
